machines.name: Leg Press Machine
machines.targetDescription: Focus on quad contraction at the top, knees tracking over toes.

machines.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
machines.targetDescription: Pulls down to upper chest, drive elbows down to contract lats.

machines.name: Seated Chest Press
machines.targetDescription: Deep stretch at bottom, squeeze inner pecs at peak extension.

machines.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
machines.targetDescription: Isolates hamstrings. Flex toes back and squeeze at bottom.

machines.name: Seated Cable Row
machines.targetDescription: Keep chest upright, pull handle to navel and retract scapula.

machines.name: Pec Deck / Butterfly Machine
machines.targetDescription: Keep slight bend in elbows, feel deep stretch in pecs.

machines.name: Seated Shoulder Press Machine
machines.targetDescription: Targets front & lateral deltoids. Avoid locking out elbows.

machines.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
machines.targetDescription: Flare rope outward at the bottom for intense lateral head lockout.

machines.name: Preacher Curl Machine
machines.targetDescription: Strict biceps isolation with arm back fully supported.

machines.name: Smith Machine Squat
machines.targetDescription: Feet slightly forward, drop hips parallel with knee joint.

machines.name: Hack Squat Machine
machines.targetDescription: Emphasizes VMO quad teardrop. Smooth controlled descent.

machines.name: Cable Lateral Raise
machines.targetDescription: Continuous tension on side delts. Raise to shoulder height.

machines.name: Calf Raise Machine
machines.targetDescription: Full stretch at bottom heel drop, explosive drive on toes.

machines.name: Abdominal Crunch Machine
machines.targetDescription: Focus on curling ribcage toward pelvis, slow eccentric.

machines.name: Treadmill Interval Run
machines.targetDescription: Track running time, distance, and cadence pace for cardiovascular endurance.

machines.name: Outdoor Distance Run
machines.targetDescription: Aerobic running session tracking total distance, time elapsed, and average pace.

exercises.ptComment: 看起來可以再加重量，不過要確保手肘在向心時不要伸直，保持微彎，胸口靠好椅墊
向心的時候，整個身體會往右上去，代表可能右背或右核心出比較多力，再加上你向心的時候，會有刻意夾背的動作，應該是要做出手肘往肋骨收進來的動作，而不是往後夾

muscleFeeling.notes:
看到影片說手肘到後面不可以前翻？要下斜方帶動？
https://youtube.com/shorts/otBHBS1_uk0?is=bVeeSUvnrB5o7Sir

exercises.ptComment: 手肘跟肩膀還是會晃動，你改成坐姿上斜的角度去操作，讓手肘在起始位置上半身後方，比較好固定肩關節跟手臂

引體向上
看得出來重量太重了，每一下保持背部張力，你會放掉再重啟
啞鈴不需舉過肩膀，啞鈴筆直舉上來就好，你會往兩側外面舉，變成前臂往外舉的過程中，也保持手肘固定
手腕不能垂下來的，一定要直，這樣才能吃到側三角

muscleFeeling.notes:
上次：
蝴蝶機夾胸向心時，背要貼緊椅墊，不要用軀幹往前帶

你上次說：「划船跟引體向上 離心手伸直的時候 就動作停止 不要再過度延伸肩胛
引體向上 的握距再窄一點 大概 1.5 倍肩寬
影片裡大概兩倍」
感覺肩膀出很多力；自從減少離心時間專心在向心，感覺大小圓、旋轉etc「背窩肉」出力多很多

exercises.ptComment: 引體向上不要刻意夾背 順順的直上直下 你會在向心的時候往前衝
啞鈴單臂划船 你離心到手伸直 動作就停 不要再刻意把肩胛往前推

muscleFeeling.notes: 三角強烈，有疑竇是平面要怎麼喬？感覺更往後可以有一個很感受度的平面
